_comment: The AgentCard the kitchen squad's manager would advertise under A2A. This is the A2A equivalent of an MCP server's tools/list: the thing another agent fetches to discover what this one can do, how to talk to it, and how to authenticate. MCP connects an agent to TOOLS; A2A connects an agent to other AGENTS.
name: kitchen-squad
description: Answers questions about a specific set of 10 recipe cards: ingredient weights, method steps, allergens, and rescaling a recipe to the amount of an ingredient the cook actually has.

provider.organization: AI Engineering League - Track B (Recipes & food)

bearer.description: A per-caller token. Read-only: this agent never writes anything, so a stolen token leaks recipe questions, not data.

skills.name: Look up what a recipe card says
skills.description: Ingredient weights, method steps, times, temperatures, storage notes and allergens, quoted from the card.
examples: How much caster sugar is in the buttermilk pancakes?
Does the traditional kimchi contain fish?

skills.name: Rescale a recipe
skills.description: Given an amount of one ingredient the cook has, returns every ingredient's weight for that batch size.
examples: I have 1 kg of cabbage, how much salt for the sauerkraut?
Scale the pizza dough to 1.5 kg of flour.

_limits.corpus: 10 recipe cards only. Anything outside them is refused rather than guessed.
_limits.no_nutrition: No calorie or nutrition data exists in the corpus; those questions are refused.
_limits.not_a_general_cooking_agent: It will not invent substitutions or food-safety advice.
